name: week
title: This week on the farm
subtitle: What needs a decision, what is booked to go, and what NAIT is waiting on

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: select priority, kind, record, issue from attention_board order by priority, kind, record

sections.title: Stock booked to go
sections.sql: select name, mob, sale_date, head, destination, whp_clear, decision from sale_readiness order by sale_date

sections.title: NAIT movements
sections.sql: select mob, kind, event_date, head, other_nait, due, nait_recorded_on, status from nait_movements order by event_date desc

sections.title: Paddocks
sections.sql: select paddock, area_ha, head, su_per_ha, cover_kg_dm, cover_age_days, rest_so_far, rest_days, decision from grazing_board order by paddock

sections.title: Recent sprays
sections.sql: select p.name paddock, s.applied_on, s.product, s.grazing_whp_days, s.applied_on + s.grazing_whp_days grazing_clear from sprays s join paddocks p on p.id = s.paddock_id order by s.applied_on desc

name: nitrogen
title: Nitrogen this season
subtitle: Synthetic N per hectare since 1 July, against the farm's cap

sections.title: By paddock
sections.sql: select paddock, land_use, area_ha, n_kg_ha, cap_kg_ha, decision from nitrogen_board order by n_kg_ha desc

sections.title: Applications
sections.sql: select p.name paddock, x.applied_on, x.product, x.rate_kg_ha, x.n_percent, round(x.rate_kg_ha * x.n_percent / 100, 1) n_kg_ha, x.area_ha from fertiliser x join paddocks p on p.id = x.paddock_id cross join season s where x.applied_on between s.starts and s.ends order by x.applied_on

sections.title: Mobs
sections.sql: select name, species, stock_class, paddock, head, round(head * su_per_head, 1) stock_units, last_weighed, whp_clear from mob_summary order by name

sections.title: Liveweights
sections.sql: select * from performance_board order by mob

sections.title: Recorded cash
sections.sql: select *, sales - purchases - animal_health recorded_cash_margin from cost_board order by mob
sections.note: Recorded purchases, animal health and sales only. Excludes stock valuation, labour, fertiliser and overheads.
